script: d=$(mktemp -d); hold(){ /bin/sh -c ': > "$1/ready"; while [ -d "$1" ] && [ ! -e "$1/go" ]; do sleep 0.01; done' sh "$d"; }; ready(){ until [ -e "$d/ready" ]; do sleep 0.01; done; }; f(){ trap 'echo got-term' TERM; hold; }; f & p=$!; ready; kill "$p"; : > "$d/go"; wait "$p"; echo "status=$?"; rm -rf "$d"
